description: This file declares the DemuxerStreamFsFCC class, a concrete implementation of an IDemuxer interface for handling Nokia FCC-related demuxing functionality, including managing communication via file system paths for channel, seek, trick play, and status operations.

classes.name: DemuxerStreamFsFCC
classes.description: A class providing an implementation of the IDemuxer interface for Nokia FCC demuxing, managing device channels, seeks, trick play, and status through file paths.

methods.name: DemuxerStreamFsFCC
methods.description: Constructor initializing file paths based on configuration and demux ID.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the demuxer device or streams.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the demuxer device or streams.

methods.name: setChannel
methods.description: Sets the current channel by writing to the channel file.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Retrieves the current channel setting from the channel file.

methods.name: setSeekPosInSeconds
methods.description: Sets the seek position in seconds via the seek file.

methods.name: getSeek
methods.description: Gets the current seek position from the seek file.

methods.name: setTrickPlaySpeed
methods.description: Sets the trick play speed via the associated file.

methods.name: getTrickPlaySpeed
methods.description: Retrieves the current trick play speed.

methods.name: getTrickPlayFile
methods.description: Returns the file path used for trick play operations.
